verdict.rationale: The pack only indirectly shows a public API for driving Claude. A help article covers developers who use LLMs to "power my product" via the Claude Console (claude-docs-56), and a community user describes Claude API features such as response prefill (claude-comm-11). The documented Enterprise Compliance API (claude-docs-11) only reads usage data and does not drive the product, and the OpenAPI probes on the support site returned 404 (claude-probe-3). Missing for 10: first-party API reference documentation, evidence of programmatic access to product features (chat, projects, Cowork), a published OpenAPI/spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
